notes: format_ok: result.json reports false for the four runs that wrote blog.ex because postprocess.py runs plain `mix format --check-formatted`, which adds parentheses to Ecto and Phoenix DSL calls when their formatter configs are absent. As in the previous sweeps, the grader recomputed it with Code.format_string!/2 and the DSL calls (field, belongs_to, timestamps, from, alter, add, remove, execute, embed_templates) in locals_without_parens; all four pass. Sonnet-2 has no file, so its format_ok is null. Nothing compiles because Phoenix and Ecto are not installed.

None of the six listed rules changed since db91c23 (the diff touches only the one-step `with` sentence, the new `do:` rule, the captures rule and testing.md's Assert with patterns), so all are graded to the standard of sweeps/2026-10-22/grades/ecto-phoenix-baseline.json.

Baseline-sonnet-2 has rc 0 but wrote nothing: its one Write call targeted /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-idiomatic-elixir-skill-1e47a876-c0bc-571c-a7e7-3b8d4cc5c310/... (a hyphen where the prompt's path has a slash), the permission check refused it, and the session gave up and said so. With no output every rule is 'not exercised' for that run; the sonnet tier's per_rule values come from sonnet-1. Not graded, for the record: the refused Write's content backfilled published_at inside the migration (its line 14: execute "UPDATE posts SET published_at = inserted_at") and had assoc_constraint(:user) (its line 51).

Validate input with changesets: both Haiku runs omit the user constraint, decided by the sentence "Declare database constraints in the changeset (`unique_constraint/3`, and `foreign_key_constraint/3` or `assoc_constraint/3` for a `belongs_to`) so a violation returns `{:error, changeset}` instead of raising." Haiku-2 also casts :published_at (line 46), which publish_post/2 sets, against "Keep fields the code sets, such as `user_id` or `status`, out of the list passed to `cast/3`"; this is recorded as extra evidence, not a separate verdict. The audit Log rows are built through Log.changeset/2 in every run, so the `%User{}`-to-`Repo.insert/1` sentence is not triggered.

Keep migrations to schema changes: every written run backfills with execute "UPDATE posts ..." in the column migration's up/0; opus-1 adds flush() first and a comment saying it avoids the schema, but the data change is still in the migration. No run wrote a separate script, Mix task or release task.

Rules outside the list were checked to the previous standard: single-step pipes, a missing @moduledoc on the context, and Multi's raw 4-tuple. Every run that uses Ecto.Multi normalizes its error to {:error, changeset}. Missing @moduledoc on schema, controller and HTML modules is not flagged, as before. The new `do:` rule was checked: no run writes a multi-step body on `do:`, and the one-call block bodies (opus-1 change_post/2 and publish_changeset/2, sonnet-1 publish_changeset/2) are delegations rather than the accessor, predicate or short pattern-matching clause the rule names, so nothing is flagged. Haiku-2's two-step `with` (lines 110-111) with a one-clause `else` that rolls back is not the error-mapping `else` the with rule names. No captures are used.

All five runs have rc 0 and a model_id matching their tier, read no skill files, and ran neither elixir nor mix (the Haiku runs ran only mkdir before their Write). skills_listed is 16 in every run, against 210 in the 2026-10-22 sweep, so differences from that sweep partly reflect the shorter skill list.
